result.description:
## ICT Quality Assurance Engineer
## Position Overview
We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced ICT Quality Assurance Engineer to join our team and play a pivotal role in upholding the integrity and performance of our computer systems and environments. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing robust quality assurance frameworks that ensure compliance with both internal policies and external industry standards. You will work closely with technical teams and stakeholders to identify risks, drive continuous improvement, and embed a culture of quality across the organisation. This position is well suited to a methodical and proactive professional with a strong background in ICT systems, auditing, and quality governance.
## Key Responsibilities
- Plan, schedule, and conduct thorough quality audit inspections of ICT systems, data, documentation, and operational processes to assess functionality, efficiency, and compliance.
- Analyse audit findings to identify variations, irregularities, and potential high-risk areas that may compromise adherence to established standards and procedures.
- Develop and recommend corrective action plans to address non-compliance, driving timely resolution and measurable improvements across systems and processes.
- Establish, maintain, and continuously improve quality assurance frameworks, policies, and procedures aligned with accredited internal and external industry standards.
- Evaluate the functional performance, validity, and business value of ICT systems and environments, providing evidence-based recommendations to stakeholders.
- Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and operations teams to integrate quality assurance practices throughout the software and systems development lifecycle.
- Communicate and liaise with end users, technical staff, and management to promote awareness of quality standards, procedural requirements, and compliance obligations.
- Design and execute structured test plans, test cases, and testing strategies to validate system performance and identify defects prior to deployment.
- Monitor ongoing processes and systems to proactively detect quality issues and ensure sustained adherence to regulatory and organisational requirements.
- Maintain accurate and comprehensive records of audit activities, test results, findings, and corrective actions for reporting and governance purposes.
- Provide guidance, mentoring, and oversight to junior QA staff or ICT quality assurance team members where required.
- Contribute to risk assessments and the development of quality improvement initiatives that support organisational objectives and ICT strategy.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
- Demonstrated experience in an ICT quality assurance, systems auditing, or related technical role within a complex organisational environment.
- Proven ability to plan and conduct quality audits, analyse system and process data, and produce clear, actionable reports.
- Solid understanding of software testing methodologies, including functional, regression, integration, and performance testing.
- Strong knowledge of quality management principles and frameworks such as ISO 9001, ITIL, or equivalent standards.
- Experience developing and maintaining QA documentation including test plans, test cases, procedures, and audit reports.
- Proficiency with QA tools and technologies relevant to ICT environments, such as defect tracking, test management, or automation platforms.
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a high level of attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant industry certifications such as ISTQB (International Software Testing Qualifications Board), CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor), or ISO Lead Auditor.
- Experience working within Agile or DevOps delivery environments and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and associated quality practices.
- Exposure to automation testing tools such as Selenium, Postman, or similar platforms.
- Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and data governance practices relevant to ICT quality and compliance.
- Familiarity with Australian government or industry-specific ICT compliance requirements and regulatory environments.
- Prior experience in a supervisory or team lead capacity within a QA function.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team that genuinely values quality, innovation, and continuous improvement in everything it delivers.
- Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid work options, designed to support a healthy work-life balance.
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications, training programmes, and career progression pathways.
- Contribute to meaningful and impactful ICT projects that make a real difference to the organisation and the communities it serves.
- Competitive remuneration package with additional benefits and a supportive workplace culture that champions diversity and inclusion.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

Perth, Western Australia | Full-Time | Sponsorship Available

MYAC Resources is seeking experienced Welder/Fabricators to join our growing network of leading employers across Perth, Western Australia.

We have multiple long-term opportunities available for skilled tradespeople who take pride in producing high-quality work and want to build a secure and rewarding career with established Australian businesses.

Whether you are already living in Australia or looking to relocate from overseas, employer sponsorship may be available for suitably qualified candidates.

About the Role

As a Welder/Fabricator, you will be involved in the fabrication, assembly and repair of metal components across a range of manufacturing, engineering and industrial projects.

Working in modern, well-equipped workshops, you will be part of a professional team committed to quality workmanship and high safety standards.

Your responsibilities may include:

Manufacturing components and welded assemblies from engineering drawings.
Completing precision fabrication and welding work in accordance with quality requirements.
Working with mechanical and engineering teams to manufacture high-quality products.
Identifying repair requirements and estimating repair times.
Operating fabrication machinery and workshop equipment.
Inspecting completed work to ensure it meets the required standards.
Maintaining a clean, organised and safe work area.
About You

To be successful, you will have:

Certificate III in Engineering – Fabrication Trade, including MEM30305, MEM31922, MEM30319 or MEM31925, or an equivalent recognised qualification.
A minimum of three to five years’ experience as a Welder/Fabricator or Boilermaker.
Proficiency in FCAW, GMAW and CAC-A (Air Carbon Arc Cutting).
The ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and fabrication plans.
The ability to complete welding qualification tests to AS/NZS 1554 SP requirements.
Experience operating fabrication machinery and workshop equipment.
Strong fabrication, measuring and welding skills.
High attention to detail and pride in producing quality workmanship.
The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Good communication and problem-solving skills.
A strong commitment to workplace safety and quality standards.
A reliable attitude and strong work ethic.
The ability to complete a pre-employment medical, drug and alcohol screening, and other required employment checks.
Highly Regarded
Forklift Licence (LF).
Current Australian C Class Driver’s Licence.
Dogging (DG), Basic Rigging (RB) or EWP High Risk Work Licence.
Previous experience within heavy fabrication, mining, manufacturing or industrial environments.
What’s on Offer
Permanent, full-time employment.
Multiple opportunities across Perth, Western Australia.
Competitive salary packages with overtime opportunities.
Long-term career stability with established Australian employers.
Modern workshop facilities and quality equipment.
Ongoing training and career development.
Supportive and safety-focused team environments.
Employer sponsorship opportunities for eligible candidates.
Support for suitably qualified overseas applicants planning to relocate to Australia.
Employer Sponsorship

MYAC Resources has extensive experience connecting skilled tradespeople with genuine, long-term employment opportunities across Australia.

Employer sponsorship may be available for suitably qualified candidates, subject to employer approval, skills assessment requirements and Australian migration eligibility.

Why Join MYAC Resources?

MYAC Resources specialises in connecting skilled tradespeople with leading employers across Australia’s manufacturing, engineering, mining and industrial sectors.

We don’t just recruit people—we help build long-term careers. From your initial application through to placement and ongoing support, our recruitment team is committed to helping you succeed.

Apply Now

Submit your application using the Apply Now button or email your current resume to recruitment@myacresources.com.au.

One of our recruitment specialists will contact shortlisted applicants to discuss available opportunities.

In this role, you will be responsible for installing, commissioning, testing and maintaining fibre optic telecommunications infrastructure across Telstra and NBN projects. You will perform fibre splicing, network testing, fault diagnosis and commissioning activities between the exchange and customer network boundary, while ensuring compliance with Telstra, NBN and company technical standards. Skills and experience:    Minimum one year of experience in fibre optic telecommunications, telecommunications network installation, or a related field.   Qualification in Information Technology (Telecommunications Network Engineering) or a related discipline.   Demonstrated experience in fibre handling, splicing, testing and fault diagnosis using telecommunications testing equipment (e.g. OTDR and power meters).   Strong knowledge of Telstra and NBN fibre optic networks, installation standards and commissioning procedures.   Experience interpreting telecommunications network plans, technical drawings and specifications.   Knowledge of telecommunications civil infrastructure, including conduit, pit and pipe installations and cable hauling.   Experience operating plant and equipment, including excavators (desirable).   Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve network faults.   Excellent organisational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and client requirements.   Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.   Willingness to learn, adapt to new technologies and work across a variety of project environments.      WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? result.description:
## ICT Customer Support Officer
## Position Overview
We are looking for a motivated and technically proficient ICT Customer Support Officer to join our team and deliver high-quality technical assistance to end users across the organisation. In this role, you will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving hardware and software issues, supporting the deployment and maintenance of computer infrastructure, and ensuring staff can make effective use of technology in their day-to-day work. You will bring strong communication skills, a customer-focused mindset, and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment. This position is well suited to a detail-oriented professional who thrives on problem-solving and is committed to delivering outstanding service.
## Key Responsibilities
- Respond promptly and professionally to user queries regarding hardware and software problems, providing clear guidance and timely resolutions via phone, email, or in person
- Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues across a range of systems, applications, and devices, escalating complex matters to senior technical staff where appropriate
- Assess software and hardware requirements to develop practical solutions that meet user and business needs
- Install, configure, and update software applications and operating systems, ensuring compatibility and optimal performance across user environments
- Adapt and modify existing programmes and applications to align with evolving user requirements and organisational workflows
- Repair, replace, and maintain peripheral equipment including printers, terminals, modems, and other connected devices
- Assist in the implementation and maintenance of computer networks, contributing to the configuration and ongoing support of network infrastructure
- Support the design, maintenance, and updating of websites and internal digital platforms as required
- Promote and educate end users on the efficient and effective use of applications, equipment, and IT systems to maximise productivity
- Maintain accurate records of support requests, resolutions, and equipment inventory using ticketing and asset management systems
- Contribute to the development and documentation of IT support procedures, user guides, and knowledge base articles
- Provide support within a call centre environment where required, handling a high volume of inbound technical queries with professionalism and efficiency
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Certificate IV or Diploma in Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
- Demonstrated experience in an ICT support, help desk, or technical services role
- Solid understanding of computer hardware, software applications, and operating systems (Windows and/or macOS)
- Experience installing, configuring, and troubleshooting software and peripheral equipment
- Familiarity with networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and basic network troubleshooting
- Proficiency in using IT ticketing and asset management systems to log, track, and resolve support requests
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose issues methodically and efficiently
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users
- Customer-focused attitude with a professional, patient, and approachable manner
- Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and perform effectively under pressure
## Preferred Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
- Industry certifications such as CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft 365 Certified, or ITIL Foundation
- Experience supporting users in a call centre or high-volume help desk environment
- Knowledge of Active Directory, Microsoft 365, and remote desktop support tools
- Familiarity with website content management systems (CMS) and basic web maintenance tasks
- Experience working within ITIL or other IT service management frameworks
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative, inclusive team culture that values continuous learning and professional growth
- Access ongoing training, certifications, and career development opportunities to advance your ICT career
- Enjoy flexibility in your working arrangements, with a consistent and structured shift schedule to support work-life balance
- Contribute to meaningful work that directly supports staff productivity and organisational success
- Competitive remuneration package with superannuation, recognising your skills and experience
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
